description: A grand hotel lobby with a marble floor, gold chandeliers and a revolving door. A young man with curly hair walks forward in a dark suit and tie that does not fit him well: the trousers stop short above his black shoes and the jacket pulls at the shoulders. Beside him a young woman in a burgundy satin slip dress holds two glasses of water and laughs with her head thrown back, then falls behind as he walks on towards the camera. Other guests in evening clothes stand by a curved wooden reception desk.
